title: Notion MCP notion-fetch returns notion-file-block:// references instead of downloadable file URLs
symptoms: page markdown from notion-fetch contains notion-file-block:// links
file download from a fetched page fails because the link is not an http URL
copied page markdown has expired signed URLs
cause: From 2026-10-05, notion-fetch no longer signs URLs for files in page blocks. It emits stable notion-file-block:// references. Files in database properties are still signed inline.
fix: Pass include_file_urls: true to notion-fetch, or call notion-get-file-download-urls with up to 25 references. Keep the references, not the URLs, when editing or copying markdown.
